// Negative case (run by TestGoSourceBridgeSliceRetainedRefusal, not the
// differ): slice storage nested inside another value cannot be reconciled by
// the buffer writeback and keeps the retention refusal. Native Go accepts this
// program; the interpreter must refuse it promptly rather than hang or corrupt.
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
)

func main() {
	a := [][]int{{1, 2}}
	b := [][]int{{1, 2}}
	fmt.Println(reflect.DeepEqual(a, b))
}
